_comment: PRIVATE CANARY room policy for ccs-2l (PREPARED, NOT DEPLOYED). Apply via the playtest host console patch (updatePlaytestPolicy) to ONE private, admin-owned, staging-database room only. The global DEFAULT_PLAYTEST_POLICY stays pfss. Procedure + abort criteria + rollback: docs/marketplank/DESIGN-PLANKCRASH-CCS2L-INTEGRATION-2026-08-31.md section 8.
perRoundAssertions: round.launched event carries the expectedCommitmentDescriptor verbatim
abortOn: any simulation invariant throw (negative liability, principal decrease)

rollback.step3: code withdrawal = revert the integration commits; replayCommittedRound still honors recorded descriptors
